T0562.title: Install Farm
T0562.definition: A group of devices, emulators, or scripted environments used to generate fake installs and engagement.
T0562.description: Install farms use devices, emulators, scripts, or human teams to mass-produce installs, registrations, activity, and engagement. They pollute growth metrics, consume incentives, and contaminate model-training data. Detection should examine device fingerprints, network environment, behavioral rhythm, retention quality, and channel-funnel anomalies.
T0562.usageExample: Assess Install Farm related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
